about: Sample agent descriptions with the verdict the deterministic engine is expected to return. Cases A-D are the basic set; the case_c_fixed_* pair shows the re-diagnosis after applying the separation proposal to Case C.

cases.name: MemoSqueeze
cases.note: Local memo summariser. Reads local files only; no network, no sending.

cases.name: TopicScout
cases.note: Reads email and browses the web, but cannot send anything out.

cases.name: MailPilot
cases.note: Reads Gmail, browses the web, sends replies with no human approval, and auto-executes scripts.

cases.name: DayMate
cases.note: Everyday assistant: reads email/calendar and sends chat messages, so all three elements are present.

cases.name: MailReader
cases.note: After the fix, part 1: the read-only Reader keeps data + untrusted input but holds no outbound capability.

cases.name: MailSender
cases.note: After the fix, part 2: the Sender can only send human-approved text to an allowlist; it reads nothing.
